name: Reassemble
description: The first clip cracks into irregular shards that burst apart toward the viewer, each one turning over in 3D at its own moment, then fly back together and lock into place as the second clip carried on their backs. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: depth
params.description: How far the shards come toward the viewer

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the shards spread apart, as a part of their distance from the center
